races.name: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Trooper
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse for Mulholland whose recent form (654-74) is modest and whose run-style leaves him reliant on a strong pace that this race is unlikely to generate; 42 days off and a step back to AW Standard following turf outings on GOO and SOF.

runners_data.name: Balgowan
runners_data.note: Strong course-and-distance profile (2W9P on Standard going) makes this 7yo the standout prominent profile in the race; Downing rides, and consecutive seconds at this track and trip confirm he travels and finishes well here — the one to anchor around for shape analysis.

runners_data.name: Man Of The Sea
runners_data.note: Mulholland's 10yo holds up naturally but has been mapped to midfield given how many true rear-dwellers are in this field; his AW form is mixed (recent outing on FIR unreliable), and a STYLE_FIT flag of 0.93 means he is unlikely to reproduce his best racing out of his preferred position.

runners_data.name: Si White
runners_data.note: Prescott's 3yo (T14: 7/26 in good form) has solid sim-going credentials (5/5 on Standard, 1W2P) and recent course form over shorter suggests improving; only 9 days since last run, and the move to 2m from 12f is the key unknown, but a handy racing style could compensate if the pace is modest.

runners_data.name: Femme Fatale
runners_data.note: The lone front-runner in the race and the pivot around which the entire shape rotates; her STYLE_FIT flag (0.92) reflects that leading is somewhat out of her natural role, but with no challenger she should control the tempo — her sim-going record at Standard is thin (1/6, 0W1P) which tempers confidence in her holding on.

runners_data.name: Sir Griflet
runners_data.note: Cunha's 3yo has a modest form string (564600) with zero wins and zero places in sim-going across 8 similar outings; hold-up style leaves him needing a pace scenario this race is unlikely to provide, and he holds little appeal on current evidence.

runners_data.name: Fabled Spirit
runners_data.note: Watson's 3yo carries a fades-in-finish flag and has been redistributed from the rear to midfield on the map — in truth he will likely try to hold up, racing behind where the chart shows; his best run (3rd on FIR) came on Fibresand, making the Standard AW surface a mild query.

runners_data.name: Last Flight
runners_data.note: Horton's 3yo is a genuine hold-up type shifted forward on the map due to field congestion at the rear; last three runs (3/5/7) on Standard going suggest he competes in this grade, and his most recent third over 14f on Standard is a form line worth noting if any pace materialises — STYLE_FIT flag applies.

runners_data.name: October Surprise
runners_data.note: West's 3yo carries both a fades-in-finish warning and a redistribution flag; his OR of 46 is the second lowest in the field and sim-going record (3/5, 0W0P) is uninspiring — a step up from 8-9f to 16f is a significant ask, and he looks likely to be outclassed.

runners_data.name: Make A Splash
runners_data.note: Ward's 3yo is the lowest-rated runner (OR=45) with only three career runs, all on going quicker than today's AW Standard; fades-in-finish flag plus redistribution from the rear compound the concern, and with no sim-going data at all this trip the case for inclusion in winning scenarios is weak.

races.paceDynamic: Femme Fatale is the lone confirmed front-runner in this 2m Lingfield AW contest and, with no genuine challenger for the lead, she should dictate a sustainable, controlled tempo from the front — a pace that suits her but is unlikely to be truly searching over this marathon trip. Balgowan is the only other runner with a prominent profile and will likely settle in second or third, giving the race a small, organised lead group and a wall of hold-up types behind. The field is saturated with hold-up horses — Fabled Spirit, Last Flight, Man Of The Sea, October Surprise and Make A Splash are all true hold-up types that the map has pushed into midfield positions they may not naturally occupy, meaning several will be competing for the same ground in the pack. With a single pace-setter setting a measured gallop, this race shape strongly favours runners who can travel prominently and pick up cleanly in the straight, giving Balgowan and any horse willing to race handy from early a material tactical advantage over the deep hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Femme Fatale Dictates Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Femme Fatale bowls along comfortably in front and the pack fails to close the gap in the straight.
scenarios.body: Femme Fatale sets a controlled pace on the front end and, with no genuine rival to press her, she retains enough energy to fend off challengers into the home straight; Balgowan, tracking in second throughout, is ideally placed to pounce if Femme Fatale weakens but also benefits from a handy position regardless.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wears Her Down
scenarios.trigger: If Femme Fatale's controlled lead proves just slow enough for a well-placed tracker to overhaul her inside the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Balgowan, having shadowed the leader throughout, uses his strong form at this course and distance (2W9P sim-going) to grind past late; Si White, who has shown improvement at this course and trip, could also pick up ground if positioned handy enough.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Comes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace quickens sufficiently in the back straight to set up a strong late run for a genuine closer.
scenarios.body: A true hold-up horse finding clear daylight in the straight could reel in a tiring leader, but most of the field's closers are redistributed types racing out of role, seriously diluting this scenario's likelihood; Last Flight and Trooper are the most credible genuine hold-up profiles if late pace materialises.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Field Bunches, Scrappy Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early crawl causes crowding, checks and interference in the home straight, scrambling the result.
scenarios.body: A falsely run race over 2m can produce a chaotic home straight where positional luck plays a large role; runners with sprint ability and quick reactions like Si White could benefit, but this shape is speculative and leans heavily on circumstantial variables.

watchPoints.text: Balgowan has course-and-distance mastery (2W9P Standard) and sits in the perfect prominent position to track Femme Fatale — watch how quickly Downing slots him into second from the gate.
Femme Fatale is the lone pace-setter but carries a STYLE_FIT flag (0.92) suggesting leading is not her natural role — watch for signs of her softening in the final 2f if the field begins to close.

Multiple hold-up horses (Last Flight, Man Of The Sea, Fabled Spirit, October Surprise, Make A Splash) will all be competing for the same ground in the back third of the field — watch for traffic problems and interference approaching the home straight.
Si White has run only over 8-12f previously; watch how he settles over the 2m distance in the early stages, as Prescott's form (T14: 7/26) suggests he may be ready for this step up in trip.

October Surprise and Make A Splash are both stepping up dramatically in trip with limited exposed form — watch their early position, as either drifting back under pressure or racing too prominently could compromise others around them.

races.name: Hyatt Inclusive Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Arctic Wind
runners_data.note: David Evans runner with modest sim-going form (0 wins, 1 place from 7 runs on Standard), returning after 37 days; in truth a hold-up horse who will struggle to find a meaningful position in a field stacked with rivals all wanting to come from off the pace, and with a style-fit score of 0.93 out of role, her chance is materially discounted.

runners_data.name: Wyle Cop
runners_data.note: Wears a hood and arrives 21 days fresh with just 1 win from 13 starts in sim-going conditions; genuinely closes from the rear but this race gives her no tactical advantage with five rivals all seeking the same ground — her recent string of mid-pack finishes (9th, 12th at 5f) suggest she needs things to fall perfectly.

runners_data.name: Go Lockers Go
runners_data.note: Michael Bell's lightly raced 3yo has the most encouraging recent form in the field (1-1-2-2-5-8 including wins at 5f Good and 5f Standard-adjacent), last ran just 8 days ago, and Ross Coakley takes the ride; despite being a natural hold-up horse, her form at this trip is the strongest here and she is the one most likely of the rear-runners to creep forward into a prominent position.

runners_data.name: Sunlit Sea
runners_data.note: Sir Mark Prescott's filly, wearing a hood, has won twice at 5f on Good ground but her Standard AW record reads 0 wins from 8 sim-going runs — a significant concern; Luke Morris rides 15 days after her last start, and while the back-to-back wins show undeniable ability, the surface switch is a clear reason to temper expectations.

runners_data.name: Carefree Dream
runners_data.note: Taylor Fisher takes the ride for J S Moore (1/13 T14), and this filly has placed five times without winning in her last five starts over the same 5f trip — consistently close but unable to seal the deal; her sim-going record (0W, 2P from 15 runs) paints a picture of a reliable but beatable hold-up performer who needs a gap to appear in the dying strides.

runners_data.name: Guernsey Lady
runners_data.note: Mapped to the front as the only identified pace-setter despite being a natural hold-up horse — J F Egan takes over for David Evans (3/18 T14) and she returns after the longest absence in the field (65 days); the redistribution to the lead is the defining tactical factor in this race, and how comfortably she settles in that unfamiliar role will determine whether she prevails or compounds inside the final furlong.

races.paceDynamic: Guernsey Lady is the sole confirmed pace-setter here, redistributed to the front having been identified as the most likely pace-maker despite her natural hold-up tendencies — she will set a sustainable, uncontested tempo over this 5f Lingfield AW straight. The remaining five runners — Arctic Wind, Wyle Cop, Go Lockers Go, Sunlit Sea, and Carefree Dream — are all genuine hold-up types, creating a unusually rear-heavy field behind the lone leader. This field contains more hold-up types than the race map can accommodate at the rear; Go Lockers Go and Carefree Dream, with their better recent form figures and prominent race-craft, are the most likely to push forward and press Guernsey Lady, while Arctic Wind and Wyle Cop are the least likely to secure an advantageous position. With a lone, uncontested leader setting a manageable gallop, horses who can travel prominently and produce a sustained challenge from mid-race are most favoured — the tactical verdict is that a horse able to sit just off the pace and quicken through the final furlong holds the clearest positional advantage in this shape.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Guernsey Lady Controls Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Guernsey Lady settles comfortably in front and the hold-up pack fails to close the gap efficiently in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Guernsey Lady dictates a measured, uncontested gallop throughout the 5f, denying the closers enough time to reel her in from the back; her lone-leader status means no rival can burn her off early, and the Standard AW surface rewards a horse that travels well without interruption.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closers Swamp Leader Late
scenarios.trigger: If Guernsey Lady's front-running role proves unnatural enough to compromise her finishing effort, leaving the door open for the hold-up horses.
scenarios.body: Go Lockers Go and Sunlit Sea, who have both shown winning ability at 5f, produce strong late runs through the closing stages as the leader ties up slightly inside the final furlong; Go Lockers Go's recent form (112258) shows consistent placed efforts at this trip and going, and Sunlit Sea's two wins at 5f on Good give her a strong profile if she can get into a rhythm from a disadvantaged position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Injected, Midfield Profits
scenarios.trigger: If Go Lockers Go or Carefree Dream push forward early, creating genuine pressure on Guernsey Lady and setting up a more contested tempo.
scenarios.body: A scrappier, higher-tempo race unfolds as two or three horses push up behind Guernsey Lady, raising the pace enough that the winner comes from a horse that sits just off the pace and finds a cleaner run; Carefree Dream and Go Lockers Go, showing the strongest form in similar going, are best placed to exploit this shape having forced the pace themselves or settled just behind it.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: All Out Blanket Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate enough that the entire field closes to within a length at the furlong pole, producing a tight photographic finish.
scenarios.body: The compact field of six over a flat 5f AW straight collapses into a wall of horses in the final 100 yards as Guernsey Lady's lead is absorbed; in this scenario the highest-rated and freshest horses — Carefree Dream (OR 68) and Guernsey Lady (OR 68) — carry the edge, but Wyle Cop's headgear and Sunlit Sea's two recent wins give them each a live chance if the race degenerates into a sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch Guernsey Lady's early demeanour in the stalls and the first furlong — if she fails to stride away naturally into the lead, this race loses its sole confirmed pace-setter and the shape collapses into a chaotic sprint with no genuine front-runner.

Go Lockers Go is the highest-form hold-up runner and bears watching for any early forward move by Ross Coakley; if she tracks Guernsey Lady closely rather than settling at the rear, she becomes the most dangerous race-shape disruptor in the field.

Sunlit Sea's two recent wins were on Good ground, not Standard AW — if the surface is playing faster than her going profile suits, Luke Morris may find her failing to quicken at the key moment despite travelling well into the final furlong.

With five hold-up horses forced to race from off the pace in a six-runner field, watch for early crowding and interference in the middle of the track as riders all seek the same ground — any horse drawn wide may benefit from a cleaner passage.

Trainer David Evans saddles both Guernsey Lady and Arctic Wind — watch for any signs of stable confidence or market moves between the two, as the yard's dual representation gives them an informational edge on which runner they expect to perform.

races.name: Bay Gardens Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: V Power
runners_data.note: Front-runner who has won twice at 14f on Standard Lingfield AW and finished eighth stepped to 16f last time; returns on just three days' rest and races here on turf-and-hood headgear, and her OR=63 gives her plenty of weight to carry at 142lbs — the key question is whether her recent 16f run has left its mark so quickly.

runners_data.name: Shopaholic
runners_data.note: Jason Watson takes a hold-up operator who shaped well when second at 14f on Standard AW 18 days ago, but has regressed since; the step back up in trip from 10f should suit a horse with a staying-on profile, though the trainer has gone 0/9 in the last 14 days and this handicap mark of OR=63 represents her career high.

runners_data.name: Artavian
runners_data.note: Prominent-style runner with hood and visor who brings course form over 16f on Standard AW — his sixth placing there in a slower-run race is relevant — and Patrick Chamings's yard has gone 0/4 recently; at OR=55 he is lightly weighted at 134lbs and represents the main on-pace threat to V Power if he elects to press from the front.

runners_data.name: Halimede
runners_data.note: Sir Mark Prescott's operation is in cracking form with seven winners from 26 runs in 14 days, and this three-year-old won over 12f at Goodwood last time; underneath the trainer angle, Halimede is a hold-up horse placed in midfield on the map purely because of field congestion at the rear — the fades-in-finish flag is a concern at this longer trip, and her form on AW Standard going reads 0/3 without a placed effort.

runners_data.name: Parc Dosne
runners_data.note: Kyle McHugh takes the claim on this lightly-raced three-year-old for the in-form Matt Crawley yard (two from three in 14 days), who has shown ability at 8-10f on Good and Soft; this is a significant step up to 13f on an AW surface she has never encountered, so the unknown quantity here is whether stamina and surface translate — all form is on Good or Soft going.

runners_data.name: Darkest Red
runners_data.note: Pat Cosgrave partners a three-year-old whose recent form string of -62224 speaks to consistent placing on Good and Soft turf, notably at 12f; as a true hold-up type placed into midfield on the map owing to overcrowding at the rear, she will likely drop to the back naturally — her surface record on AW Standard is just 0/1 and the Jim Boyle yard has gone 2/12 in the last fortnight, offering some trainer support.

runners_data.name: Cospicua
runners_data.note: James Tate sends out a three-year-old with two wins from seven runs at 12f on Standard AW, giving her the strongest course-and-distance profile in the hold-up group; returning after 58 days off, she is another genuine closer placed forward on the map simply because true rear-dwellers are over-represented in this field — her fitness after the layoff is the primary concern rather than any doubt about her liking for the surface.

races.paceDynamic: V Power is the sole confirmed front-runner in a field of seven over 1m5f on Standard Lingfield AW, and with no genuine challenger for the lead, she will control the pace entirely from the outset — likely dictating at a sustainable, metronomic tempo that suits a horse who has led to win at this track and trip. The hold-up brigade — Darkest Red, Halimede, and Cospicua — are all genuine off-the-pace types who have been redistributed into midfield on the map simply because the field is stacked with closers; in reality, they will drift towards the rear and face a longer run to the line than their natural game demands. Artavian, the other prominent-style runner, will likely slot in just off V Power's shoulder and could act as a pacemaking foil without truly challenging for the lead. This race shape — a single uncontested leader setting a measured pace over a stiff 1m5f — strongly favours prominent racers and horses who can travel close to the pace through the middle stages, as those held up off a modest tempo face a steep ask when the leader's cushion proves hard to claw back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: V Power Controls Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If V Power leads alone at a steady pace and the hold-up horses fail to close the gap from the rear.
scenarios.body: V Power sets an uncontested, controlled tempo and Artavian slots in second, meaning the prominent pair have the race run to their strengths while the closers burn energy chasing from the back; a steady pace over 1m5f on AW rewards horses who settle close to the action and quicken from a position of comfort.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closer Delivers Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong enough to leave V Power exposed in the final two furlongs, giving a hold-up horse a live chance.
scenarios.body: A slightly brisker early tempo — perhaps forced by Artavian pressing more keenly — could drain V Power's reserves late, opening the door for one of the closers to finish with authority; Darkest Red's consistent placed form at 12f on Good and Soft is the best hold-up profile in the field, though she must overcome a style-fit disadvantage on this surface.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Stalker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If V Power fades quickly and a mid-division horse who has travelled smoothly inherits the lead approaching the final turn.
scenarios.body: A horse like Parc Dosne — stepping up from 10f trips — or Shopaholic, who showed a staying-on second at 14f on this surface, could benefit if the race falls apart in front of them; this scenario is modestly likely given the redistributed horses are not true mid-division types and their tactical flexibility is limited.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the leader fades sharply and there is no horse positioned to capitalise, turning the finish into a chaotic scramble.
scenarios.body: With most true hold-up runners tracking wide and late, and V Power potentially running out of fuel after a strong early effort on just three days' rest, a ragged finish with no clean winner profile is possible; Halimede, trained by Sir Mark Prescott with seven winners in the last 14 days, is the wildcard — a three-year-old whose sole win came at 12f on Good and who must prove this AW surface and this trip are within range.

watchPoints.text: Watch V Power's jumping-off point at the start — if she establishes a clear, uncontested lead through the first two furlongs, the race is likely hers to lose and no one can bridge the gap from the hold-up positions behind her.

Cospicua's 58-day absence is the single biggest stamina-and-fitness unknown in the race; if she returns short of peak fitness, the remaining hold-up horses Darkest Red and Halimede inherit her role as the most dangerous closer, but none of the three have a strong AW Standard profile.

Artavian's early positioning will shape the entire contest — if he presses V Power hard from the outset rather than sitting second, the pace quickens and the closers get a genuine chance; if he settles behind her quietly, the lead duo may control the race between them.

Parc Dosne's debut on AW and step up from 10f to 13f represent two simultaneous unknowns — Kyle McHugh's claim saves 7lbs but trainer Matt Crawley's two recent winners have come in different race types, so treat this runner as a significant unknown quantity rather than a live threat until the race pattern becomes clear.

Sir Mark Prescott's yard form with Halimede is worth monitoring given seven wins in 14 days, but the fades-in-finish flag combined with a 0/3 record on AW Standard suggests the trainer angle alone is insufficient to override a structural concern about how this horse finishes races on this surface.

races.name: Calabash Cove EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Kanzi
runners_data.note: Won on debut at Goodwood over 7f on Good going and steps up to a mile here, with Callum Shepherd retaining the ride for Charlie Johnston; as the only confirmed front-runner she takes her natural lead role and the flat Standard AW track suits her style, though the style-fit tag is a mild flag if the pace conversation changes.

runners_data.name: Norfolk Dream
runners_data.note: Finished eighth on debut over 7f on Standard AW going, and that sim-going record (1 run, 0 wins, 0 places) offers little encouragement; a confirmed hold-up type who fades late, she needs a genuine gallop to have any chance of reaching the principals, and the likely steady pace makes life very difficult from the back.

runners_data.name: Ozone Friendly
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with going and style both unknown, making her the biggest wildcard in the field; Harry Davies partners her for James Owen, who has a solid 14-day strike rate, and she cannot be ignored purely on the grounds of unexposed potential, but she carries significant unknowns into a race with a defined pace map.

runners_data.name: Saffron Bay
runners_data.note: Another debutante or near-debut runner with unknown style and going preference, saddled by Charles Hills with Rob Hornby aboard — a reliable combination; without knowing how she will travel or settle, she is best treated as a lightly-weighted unknown quantity who could improve the race shape if she shows early speed.

runners_data.name: Senorita Luna
runners_data.note: Seventh on debut over 7f on Standard AW going mirrors Norfolk Dream's experience almost exactly, and Benoit de la Sayette takes over for Marco Botti; as a genuine hold-up type with a fading profile, she is unlikely to threaten unless the pace is far stronger than this single front-runner setup suggests.

runners_data.name: Amethyst Star
runners_data.note: Two runs show a tenth at Goodwood over 6f on Good and a seventh at 6f on Soft, so stepping up to a mile on Standard AW is a significant change of context; Callum Hutchinson rides for Eve Johnson Houghton, and her prominent style means she at least gets to race in a position from which she can influence the result if Kanzi weakens.

runners_data.name: Chaise Longue
runners_data.note: Eighth on debut over 7f at Goodwood on Good going for Ed Dunlop; a genuine hold-up type in natural style, she has been pushed to a midfield mapping here because the rear of the field is already crowded with similar types, and Jason Watson will need to find a tactical solution if she is to be competitive — the style-fit discount applies.

races.paceDynamic: Kanzi is the sole confirmed pace-setter in this seven-runner field and, with no rival likely to seriously contest for the lead, she should bowl along at a controlled, sustainable gallop from the front on this Standard Lingfield AW mile. Amethyst Star will press from a prominent position just off Kanzi's heels, giving the race a modest early tempo rather than a true test of stamina. The hold-up trio of Norfolk Dream, Senorita Luna, and Chaise Longue will be anchored at the rear, though Chaise Longue has been redistributed to midfield on the map as the field holds more genuine hold-up types than can all be placed at the back — Norfolk Dream and Senorita Luna are most likely to occupy the deepest positions. The race shape strongly favours the front-running and prominent profiles: a single uncontested leader dictating a comfortable gallop on a flat track creates ideal conditions for the pace-setter to quicken clear and for those travelling just off the pace to pick up the pieces, while the true closers face a longer task against a steady sectional.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Kanzi Controls And Quickens
scenarios.trigger: If Kanzi leads uncontested and sets a steady-to-moderate gallop that she can sustain into the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Kanzi dictates every fraction of the race from the front and, never pressured, finds an extra gear in the closing stages on a flat track that rewards controlling front-runners; the prominent Amethyst Star, travelling just behind, is ideally positioned to capitalise if Kanzi wavers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Sweeps Through
scenarios.trigger: If Kanzi's early gallop is slightly too strong and she ties up, allowing a well-placed prominent or midfield runner to surge past.
scenarios.body: Amethyst Star or one of the lightly-raced unknown quantities in Ozone Friendly and Saffron Bay, sitting comfortably two to three lengths off the pace, arrives with a decisive run as Kanzi fades inside the final furlong; this suits a horse with a clean turn of foot rather than raw stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Collars Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is unusually strong early and the entire field is strung out, leaving a late finisher with ground to make up in the straight.
scenarios.body: Norfolk Dream or Senorita Luna, sitting deepest, would need a genuine end-to-end gallop to reel in the front-runners on this flat mile, but both have form at similar going and distance; their finishing chance is undermined by the likelihood of a steady early pace that gives hold-up types too much to do.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos From Lightly Raced Runners
scenarios.trigger: If one or both of the debut or near-debut runners in Ozone Friendly and Saffron Bay show unexpected pace or ability to disrupt the expected shape.
scenarios.body: An unknown quantity breaking smartly could upset Kanzi's uncontested lead or inject pace that scrambles the field's positioning; in that scenario a horse with natural tactical versatility and class background gains an edge, but the probability remains low given how cleanly Kanzi profiles as the sole pace-setter.

watchPoints.text: Kanzi's early stride pattern in the first two furlongs — if she is allowed a completely uncontested lead she becomes very difficult to peg back on this flat mile, making her the fulcrum of the entire race shape.

Ozone Friendly and Saffron Bay are both unknown quantities on debut or near-debut; either could break sharply and inject unexpected early pace that forces Kanzi to work harder than anticipated, compressing the field's race shape.

Norfolk Dream and Senorita Luna both faded on their sole AW starts and are confirmed hold-up types — if the pace is anything less than genuine they face an almost impossible task catching a front-runner who is never extended.

Chaise Longue, a true hold-up horse mapped to midfield due to field congestion at the rear, needs Jason Watson to find clear running early in the straight; any traffic problems in the pack will cost her the chance of a late challenge.

Amethyst Star's best trip to date has been 6f, and this step to a mile on a flat AW track is an unknown — if she travels kindly just off Kanzi's pace she is the most likely beneficiary of any late fade, but stamina doubts over the longer trip are worth monitoring.

races.name: Hewanorra Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Rogue Supremacy
runners_data.note: Hold-up operator for Archie Watson who has consistently struggled to land a blow from the rear at 6f, stepping up to 7f here which offers marginal hope, but 0 wins from 15 similar-going runs and poor recent form (5 finishes of 7-9) make this a tough ask.

runners_data.name: Arantes Nascimento
runners_data.note: Has winning form at 7f on Standard AW (1 win, 5 placings from 15 sim-going runs) and a second from this trip last time; Benoit de la Sayette is a sharp tactician who will slot just off Huscal and is ideally placed to exploit the expected steady tempo.

runners_data.name: Tattie Bogle
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer with headgear (p) who has placed at 7f on Good and Soft, but his sim-going figures on AW Standard are modest (0W 2P from 5); Charlie Johnston's yard has strong form at the meeting (T14: 5/44) and this horse's pressing style is well-suited to the expected race shape.

runners_data.name: Red Hat Eagle
runners_data.note: Genuinely a hold-up type by nature, though the race map shows it in midfield because there are more rear-of-field horses than positions; headgear (p) worn, and its six-run winless run at 7f on Good ground tempers confidence, with STYLE_FIT 0.93 flagging it will likely race out of its best comfort zone.

runners_data.name: Bold Suitor
runners_data.note: Remarkably consistent AW performer (3W 9P from 15 Standard runs) whose entire record is built on prominent racing, but the redistribution means it is shown in midfield — if it cannot assert its natural position behind Huscal, its considerable form profile is partially undermined; 59 days off is a mild watch point despite trainer Craig Benton having only one qualifier in 14 days.

runners_data.name: Huscal
runners_data.note: Confirmed pace-setter for Charles Hills carrying top weight (140lbs) and a tongue tie, with a STYLE_FIT flag (0.94) suggesting some risk of racing beyond its optimal tactical comfort zone; AW Standard form is thin (0W 2P from 3) and recent runs on Good ground have been modest, though the uncontested lead is a significant advantage.

runners_data.name: Port Road
runners_data.note: The most compelling AW profile in the race — 3 wins and 7 places from 13 Standard-going runs at this course and distance — and has won at 7f on Standard twice in recent history; Harry Davies rides and Simon Dow's yard is cold (T14: 0/7), but the horse's hold-up style needs the race to be run at a stronger pace than Huscal is likely to set.

races.paceDynamic: Huscal is the confirmed front runner and, with no genuine challenger for the lead, will dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop from the off on Standard Lingfield AW. Arantes Nascimento and Tattie Bogle are the natural prominent horses most likely to track Huscal closely through the first half of the race, leaving the backmarkers — Rogue Supremacy and Port Road — to race from further back in a race unlikely to be run at a truly searching tempo. This field holds more prominent and hold-up types than the race shape can naturally accommodate: Bold Suitor and Red Hat Eagle are genuine prominent and hold-up horses respectively but are displaced to midfield in this map, with Arantes Nascimento and Tattie Bogle best-placed to secure the positions closest to Huscal. A controlled pace set by a single, uncontested front runner on a flat AW track strongly favours horses able to race prominently and quicken from a stalking position, rather than true hold-up types who will need a finish they are unlikely to get at this tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Huscal Dictates, Stalkers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Huscal trots up uncontested to lead and the pace remains measured throughout.
scenarios.body: Huscal rolls along at a controlled tempo, with Arantes Nascimento and Tattie Bogle ideally positioned just off the pace to pounce in the final two furlongs; the lack of pressure on the leader means the race turns into a tactical sprint from the two-furlong pole, rewarding horses with a turn of foot from a prominent pitch.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Defies Field
scenarios.trigger: If Huscal's controlled pace proves just fast enough to deny the stalkers a target, and the field fails to quicken past.
scenarios.body: Huscal, carrying a tongue tie and ridden by Jason Watson, settles into a rhythm that is just outside the comfort zone of the chasers, converting a prominent run into a front-running hold on; this scenario is mildly discounted by Huscal's modest Standard AW form (3/15 runs) and a [STYLE_FIT] flag.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Types Arrive Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens materially from halfway and creates enough of a test to bring the genuine hold-up horses into play.
scenarios.body: Port Road, with a strong AW record (13/15 sim-going, 3 wins) and proven Lingfield form, would be the chief beneficiary if a strong pace string out the field; however, both Bold Suitor and Red Hat Eagle are redistributed out of their natural roles here, making this scenario structurally unlikely to deliver as the horses who would win it are not racing from their true positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Redistribution Chaos, Wide Open
scenarios.trigger: If Bold Suitor and Red Hat Eagle successfully wrestle back their natural racing positions, disrupting the expected race shape entirely.
scenarios.body: A messy early race with multiple horses contesting positions would compress the field and potentially produce an unusually fast early pace, bringing the field together for a blanket finish; Bold Suitor's excellent AW profile (15/15 sim-going, 3 wins, top weight carrier) makes it dangerous if it lands its natural prominent berth, but this scenario depends on conditions that are improbable given Huscal's confirmed lead role.

watchPoints.text: Arantes Nascimento's AW 7f record and Benoit de la Sayette's positional awareness make it the most naturally placed horse to benefit if Huscal dawdles — watch for it to be asked to go two furlongs out.

Port Road's superior AW record (13/15, 3 wins) is genuine but its hold-up style is structurally disadvantaged in a race Huscal will likely run at a controlled tempo — monitor early pace before committing to it.

Bold Suitor needs to reclaim a prominent position from its redistributed midfield map slot; if Georgia Dobie pushes forward early to sit behind Huscal, it becomes considerably more dangerous than its mapped role suggests.

Huscal is carrying the highest weight in the field (140lbs) and has never won on Standard AW — if it fades from the front in the final furlong, the horses immediately behind it (Arantes Nascimento, Tattie Bogle) are first to benefit.

Rogue Supremacy and Red Hat Eagle both need a stronger pace than this race shape is likely to produce — if either makes an uncharacteristic move to improve position from the three-furlong mark, it may signal jockey intent worth noting.

races.name: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes

runners_data.name: Henry Tudor
runners_data.note: Won over this C&D 25 days ago (1/6f/STA), strong form fit, but is a true hold-up horse who may find himself pressed further forward than ideal in this pace-compressed field; Luke Morris will need to navigate traffic.|

runners_data.name: Horus
runners_data.note: Tongue-tie and hood-wearing hold-up horse for Attwater, has posted five consecutive AW 6f runs with modest returns (best a 4th); 60-day absence is a concern and sim-going record of 0W1P from 15 gives little encouragement.|

runners_data.name: Just King High
runners_data.note: Tongue-tie and blinkers for Burdon, a natural closer whose true style may be squeezed by the cluster of hold-up types in this field; best recent effort was a 4th over 7f on Standard, and the drop to 6f may not help.|

runners_data.name: Rainbow Sorbet
runners_data.note: Visor-wearing hold-up type with a poor sim-going record (0W0P from 6 runs on Standard); two AW 6f runs have produced 7th and 8th, and without a pace to chase this horse looks vulnerable in a field-led race.|

runners_data.name: Roman Spring
runners_data.note: The only other prominent-style runner, and 1W2P from 15 on similar going endorses course competence; however, all five recent runs have come on Good ground at 5-6f, and switching to AW Standard is an unknown — the one most likely to occupy second slot behind Kane.|

runners_data.name: Music And Song
runners_data.note: A 3yo stepping down sharply from 10f turf races to 6f AW, flagged for fading finishes and without an AW start in its history; mapped to midfield but naturally a hold-up type, and the combination of trip compression and surface switch makes this a difficult ask.|

runners_data.name: Paint Your Palette
runners_data.note: Tongue-tie, three runs all ending 11th-13th on soft/good-to-firm over 7-8f, no AW experience, and a natural closer mapped away from its ideal position; the weakest profile in the field by some margin.|

runners_data.name: A Lott Of Kane
runners_data.note: The lone front-runner, 2W4P from 9 on similar going with back-to-back wins at 5-6f on Standard — lightly weighted at 137lbs for a 3yo and fresh enough at just 9 days since last run; controls pace fate entirely and is the central tactical reference point for the whole race.|

runners_data.name: Dr Ali
runners_data.note: Visor, won over this C&D in last five (1/6f/STA), strong sim-going record of 2W4P from 15, and a genuine hold-up horse who needs something to aim at; Jonny Peate rides and the redistribution means he may sit closer to the pace than usual, which could actually suit given the likely sedate gallop.|

runners_data.name: Edergole's Gift
runners_data.note: Tongue-tie and blinkers, has placed third over 7f Standard and shown some consistency, but all recent runs have been over 7f and the drop to 6f on AW is untested; a natural hold-up horse likely to find himself at the back of a pace-light race.|

races.paceDynamic: A Lott Of Kane is the sole confirmed front-runner and, with no meaningful challenger for the lead, will dictate from the off at a controlled, sustainable gallop over Lingfield's flat 6f AW strip. Roman Spring is the only other prominent-style runner and will likely track in second, creating a small lead group with minimal early pressure. Behind them, the field is saturated with hold-up types — Henry Tudor, Just King High, Music And Song, Paint Your Palette, and Dr Ali are all natural closers, but the map cannot accommodate them all at the rear; Henry Tudor, Just King High, and Dr Ali are the most likely to actually secure a position closer to the pace given their recent course form and competitive ratings, while the others drift further back than ideal. This race shape — a controlled pace set by one horse, modest pressure from one tracker — overwhelmingly favours prominent and efficient hold-up horses that can travel just off the lead and pounce in the final furlong, rather than deep closers who need genuine pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Kane Controls, Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If A Lott Of Kane leads at a steady clip and Roman Spring or a rival tracks efficiently, the race is run to suit horses just off the pace who can quicken from a prime position.
scenarios.body: A Lott Of Kane sets a metronomic tempo, Roman Spring tracks in second, and the winner emerges from the top three or four with a smooth, well-timed run into the straight; this is the textbook shape for this field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Deliver Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is deceptively quick early and the front runners tie each other up, giving genuine closers a target to aim at.
scenarios.body: A Lott Of Kane and Roman Spring push each other harder than expected, flattening out inside the final furlong and leaving a gap for the chasing pack; Dr Ali and Henry Tudor, both with winning form at 6f on this surface, are best placed to exploit this.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If A Lott Of Kane leads at a walk and faces zero serious challenge, allowing it to conserve energy and sprint clear when asked.
scenarios.body: With the field of hold-up types unable to close from too far back, A Lott Of Kane simply bowls along uncontested and has enough in reserve to hold every challenger; its 2W from 9 runs on similar going and recent winning form on this exact surface makes this a credible outcome.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos — No Shape
scenarios.trigger: If there is a stumble, interference, or the pace collapses entirely leaving several horses stranded out of position.
scenarios.body: Paint Your Palette or Music And Song, both step-down runners from longer trips with limited evidence on 6f AW, would need a truly scrambled race to get involved; their fading finishes and step up in pace profile make this the least likely route to success.

watchPoints.text: A Lott Of Kane — if it jumps cleanly and gets an uncontested lead, it controls the entire shape of the race; watch whether Roman Spring attempts to push it early, as that single variable decides whether the pace is honest or falsely slow.

Dr Ali and Henry Tudor — both won over this C&D recently and are capable of handling the redistribution into a midfield slot; if either secures a position just behind the lead pair rather than being buried in the hold-up pack, they become significantly more dangerous.

Music And Song and Paint Your Palette — both are stepping down sharply in trip and/or switching surface with no AW form, and both carry fading-finish flags; in a slowly-run 6f they are likely to find themselves too far back to mount any meaningful challenge.

Roman Spring — sole prominent rival to A Lott Of Kane, all recent runs on Good turf; monitor how it handles the AW surface in the early stages, as any reluctance or sluggishness on the kickback would remove the only source of tactical pressure on the leader.
